round22_result.summary: 16 of 24 byte-exact, the best rate of any round. 24 targets needed 19 sources: 002c1a58/002c1aa0 and the five-member 002cff98 family were detected as byte-identical from the range hashes before any source was written.

exact.mechanism: symbol address materialised with lui+addiu and held in $s0 across both calls
byte load + sltiu guard; DAT declared 0x33f210 (target lui 0x33 / lw -3568)
three named variables so the masked value keeps its own register ($t7) instead of being folded into the boolean
call result live across two calls stays in $s0; returned value copied back at the end
byte flag global declared volatile u8; DAT_01d58cb8 declared 0x1d58cb8
global read into a local before the guarded pair of calls, then cleared
named pointer temp at param_1+0xa0 indexed [3]; DAT declared 0x1dae6e4
symbol addresses (lui+addiu); 32-bit return keeps the 16-byte frame (a u64 spelling widened it to 32)
a 4-argument call with one plain literal and one symbol address; store through the call result
vtable setter: symbol-address store, two calls at byte offsets, third call on the parameter, trailing empty asm

unresolved.reason: GCC sinks both prologue saves below the first call because the first call's result is used only as a later argument. This is the prologue-sink class seen on 0028b7f8, 00315678, 00315700 and 00316890.
attempts: v01 plain with a volatile global store

unresolved.reason: GCC hoists the byte store at +2792 above the word stores even when every store is volatile. Same shape as round 12's 001668f8, which was never solved.
attempts: v03 named pointer plus volatile byte store

unresolved.reason: Byte-identical body to 002c1a58 (sha256 1f9fc7f9...), so it carries exactly the same blocker. No separate source was written.

GCC emits the four consecutive word stores in reverse source order and keeps the 64-bit store first, regardless of volatile. Source order was tried ascending and descending; volatile was tried on one store and on all five.
The target spills a1 to 0(sp) and a2 to 16(sp) and never reloads them; GCC elides dead stores and frames at -32 instead of -48. Same dead-spill class as 002ef340.
GCC emits sw zero,60(s0) before sw zero,80(s0) and does not respect volatile on either. Store-ordering class.
attempts: v04 volatile on the last store

unresolved.reason: The target keeps param_1*4 in $t6 across the call and needs only one saved register; any named pointer forces a second callee-saved register and a 32-byte frame.
attempts: v02 byte-offset arithmetic without a named pointer (regressed)

unresolved.reason: INCONSISTENT lui/lw PAIR. The target wants lui 0x34 together with lw -13580(t7). Those halves imply different addresses: lui 0x34 with that offset is 0x33caf4, but declaring 0x33caf4 emits lui 0x33. No single declared value produces both. Same phenomenon as round 14's 0020f118.

compiler_level_findings: STORE REORDERING (new class, 2 members: 002e5f70, 0019da20, plus 002c1a58): GCC 3.2 emits consecutive same-base stores in reverse source order and does not respect volatile on them. 002e5f70 was tried ascending, descending, partly volatile and fully volatile; none produced the target order.

INCONSISTENT lui/lw PAIR (new class, 1 member: 0022b7f0): a target pair whose hi half and signed lo half imply different addresses cannot be produced from any single declared value. First seen on 0020f118 in round 14, now confirmed with a minimal case.
PROLOGUE SINK (existing, 002a9ce8 joins): both prologue saves sink below the first call when that call's result is used only as a later argument.
picker_lessons: Excluding the three classes proven unreachable up front (frame-pointer s8, movz/movn, lq/sq) is what produced 16/24; round 20 scored 0/16 with a batch dominated by frame-pointer wrappers.
Duplicate detection from the r22_range_hashes.txt BEFORE writing sources saved five probes, as the round-20 post-mortem predicted.
The ATTEMPTED harvest must read a.get('address') as well as bare strings, and must skip non-string list members.
process_notes: Three v02 files were never created because a Python assertion aborted the generator mid-script, and a non-composable replace helper silently dropped a fix from 00188bb0 so that v02 probed identically to v01. Always confirm the variant file exists before reading its probe output.
Taking the address of a global declared only by an asm(".globl ...") block fails to compile - a matching extern of the right type is required. This bit three separate sources this round.
Reading the immediate off dis.py rather than recomputing it fixed 00188bb0 and 001ea928; both had been one or several words away purely on my own arithmetic.
